selection: the single member enwik8 of the zip, all 100,000,000 bytes (the first 10^8 bytes of the English Wikipedia XML dump of 2006-03-03)
train_batch_schedule: step k zero-based, row b: bytes[(k*batch*2048 + b*2048) % (100000000 - 2049) : start+2049]; targets shifted one byte (tools/lm_step_memory_probe.py --corpus, tools/torch_lm_step_opponent.py); a timing run of a few steps reads inside train_range

benchmark.name: enwik8 (Hutter Prize file), byte-level language modeling
benchmark.split: 90M train / 5M validation / 5M test, as in the Transformer-XL enwik8 script

scope: English-text kind for the two-corpus neural rule (ENGINEERING_RULES section 9, from 2026-09-11 night); input.txt is fetched by tools/fetch_corpus_enwik8.sh and is not committed
